summary: Diff adds a full frontend component set (hero/services/products/gallery/contact/inquiry form), an admin page with Internet Identity-based gating, and a Motoko backend actor with createInquiry/listInquiries plus additional access-control and user-profile features. However, key acceptance criteria around stable persistence and inquiry timestamps/created time are not evidenced in the backend types/state shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Inquiries are persisted in canister stable state (survive reload).
missing_requirements.reason: The backend stores inquiries in an in-memory Map and `nextInquiryId` var, but there is no evidence of `stable` variables or `preupgrade/postupgrade` logic to persist inquiries across upgrades/reloads.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin table shows at least: created time, name, phone, message.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend `Inquiry` type contains only `name`, `phone`, `message` (no timestamp). The admin table component comment explicitly states backend doesn't provide timestamps, indicating created time cannot be displayed as required.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile management (save/get user profiles) and a required profile setup flow before admin usage.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not ask for user profiles or a profile-setup modal; it only requires an admin inquiries view behind Internet Identity.

hallucinated_features.description: Custom access-control initialization via a secret URL parameter (`caffeineAdminToken`) and authorization mixins/modules.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest specifies a basic admin allowlist check in code using caller principal; it does not request secret-token bootstrapping via URL params or additional authorization modules.

hallucinated_features.description: Dark mode/theme switching infrastructure via `next-themes` ThemeProvider.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requests a cohesive teal/green theme with red accents, but does not request theme toggling or dark mode support.
Not requested in the BuildRequest requirements/non-goals.
